label: miso 45 cc capacity
definition: miso-45 (G-23 root-cause fix): miso-44 recipe + cc_capacity_reconcile with the MISO demonstrated-capacity cap table (derive_cc_capacity_reconcile.py --iso MISO --mode cap). Root cause of the CC_REGULAR +20 TWh overrun: EIA-860 reports 7 MISO CC plants' steam (CA) rows with BLOCK-level Summer Capacity while nameplate stays component-level; the loader's summer-preferred pmax double-counts the CTs (-2,714 MW phantom, 6 of 7 plants MISO-South, e.g. Union Power 3,457 MW modeled vs 2,428 nameplate / 2,318 CAMPD p99.9 / 2,354 EIA-860 winter). Cap = plant's own measured CAMPD p99.9 sustained peak - zero new DOF. RESULT vs miso-44: CC_REGULAR +20.0/+19.1/+3.1 -> +6.7/+7.2/-7.3 TWh; ST_GAS -8.5/-11.0/-10.5 -> -2.0/-4.6/-6.1; C1 12/16 -> 15/16 (free 8/12 -> 11/12); C3b PASS. 2025 residual moves onto the open import-starvation + coal-sigmoid rows (audit boxes 3-4). Full audit: docs/multi-iso/miso-cc-overrun-rootcause-2026-07.md. Determination stays NOT-YET (same class as miso-44): four load-bearing/supporting FAILs remain open — C1 2024 ST_GAS -9.87 TWh; C2 2025 gas -10.8% / coal +16.8%; C3a 2025 mean LMP -10.5%; C3c 2024/2025 scarcity-tail hours model 0h vs DA actual 24h/38h — plus a C5a CO2 CAVEAT (commercial-band, 2025 +7.1%) and C5b/C5c storage CAVEATs (ledgered: MISO's EIA-930 series carries no pumped-storage breakout, so the model's PS+battery discharge is scored against a battery-only actual). The promotion is on the CC-capacity root-cause fix and DOF reduction, not on these FAILs or caveats closing.
market_story: Floors force <0.6 TWh total (all four enabled MISO limbs are design-day commitment floors: hot-day coal/CT/ST_GAS units are online before the peak because operators commit against the design cooling/heating day, not the price of the hour). The miso-45 keeper-vs-twin per-class deltas are near-zero by construction - the run's structural content is the measured demonstrated-capacity cap, which is in BOTH twins; nothing in the CC row is floor-bought.
